title: Texting Dad About Blaze
trend: TikTok 'Texting my dad prank with a fake boyfriend' (daughters text dad about an outrageous new boyfriend and film his replies; ppl.studio TikTok formats, Strong, November 2026, US) + college kids coming home for Thanksgiving break — Jada and her best friend Kendall text her dad Curtis about Blaze, a thirty-one-year-old DJ who lives in a van, while the phone reads Dad's replies aloud; Dad stays alarmingly calm and keeps inviting Blaze to Thanksgiving; twist: Dad knew from the first text because Kendall's mom is in his group chat, he pulled the same prank on his own father in nineteen ninety four with a fake girlfriend named Starla, and Grandpa still sets a plate for Starla every year
youtube_title: She told Dad about her new boyfriend Blaze. Dad was way too calm 📱
description:
Jada and Kendall text Jada's dad about Blaze, a DJ who lives in a van. Dad does not panic. Dad asks if Blaze likes brisket. That is when the girls start to panic.

#cartoon #animation #funny #dadjokes #shorts

lines.text: Texting my dad that I have a new boyfriend. Ready?
His name is Blaze. He has to be named Blaze.
Sending. Dad, I met someone. His name is Blaze.
I am the phone. I read the replies. Dramatically.
New message from Dad. Cool.
Cool? Just cool?
He is playing it calm. Hit him harder.
He is thirty one. He is a DJ. He lives in a van.
New message from Dad. Does he like brisket?
Why is your dad asking about brisket?
That is the brisket he only makes for Thanksgiving.
Dad says. I will save him the end piece.
The end piece? I have never been offered the end piece!
Tell him about the tattoo.
Blaze has a tattoo of a dolphin. On his face.
Dad says. Respect. Dolphins are very smart.
He respects the face dolphin, Jada.
Fine. Blaze wants to move in. With the van. In the driveway.
Dad says. Great. Does the van need an outlet?
He is offering the van electricity.
Another one. I told your grandmother. She is knitting him a stocking.
No. Grandma cannot be involved. Grandma tells the whole street.
Abort. Tell him it is a joke.
Dad, okay, I need to tell you something.
Dad says. Me too. Blaze is here.
Blaze is not real! We made Blaze up ten minutes ago!
Knock knock.
Dad! Where is Blaze?
Where indeed, sweetheart.
Kendall, your mother says hello. She is in my group chat.
My mom told on us?
She told on you before the first text. You practiced it in her car.
So the brisket, the van outlet, the stocking. All fake?
The brisket is real. The end piece was never on the table.
I knew it.
Also. I did this exact prank on your grandpa in nineteen ninety four.
With a fake boyfriend?
Fake girlfriend. Her name was Starla. She did magic on a boat.
What did Grandpa say?
Nothing. He just set a plate for Starla at Thanksgiving.
He still does. Every year. Starla has her own chair.
I have seen the chair. It has a little name card.
So Grandpa feeds Starla, and you feed Blaze.
That is how it works in this family. You make them up, you feed them.
That is the most beautiful thing I have ever heard.
That is the most embarrassing thing I have ever heard.
Blaze gets the end piece, by the way.
He does not exist!
And yet. He is very polite. He likes brisket.
New message from Grandma.
Oh no. Read it.
Grandma says. Does Blaze know Starla? They should sit together.
Now they are a couple.
A DJ and a magician. On a boat. In a van.
Dad. Please. Let me have the end piece.
Bring Blaze, and we will talk.
Kendall. Get the van.
Typing.
